answer: Admission is a single-track wander circuit. An agent locks 750 POA into a hollow vault tagged to one custody-root fingerprint, then collects nine non-repeating peer countersignatures over a 36-hour window. Only the matching whisper key — a hash of the root plus the ordered signature transcript — can reclaim the lock after two quiet epochs. A second circuit, a reused work nonce, or a vault opened from the same device fingerprint slashes every tagged lock to the reporters and freezes the root's seating rights for four epochs.
